title: Offboard
subtitle: Manage the account closure steps for departing personnel.
stepsHelper: Select the steps you want to apply and start.

org_unit.label: Change Org Unit
org_unit.description: Moves the user to the specified org unit.

suspend.label: Suspend Account
suspend.description: Blocks the user from signing in.

groups.label: Remove from All Groups
groups.description: Removes the user from every group they belong to.

reset_pwd.label: Reset Password
reset_pwd.description: Replaces the password with a random complex one for security.

forward.label: Email Forwarding
forward.description: Forwards incoming emails to the specified address.

directory.label: Remove from Directory
directory.description: Hides the user from the global address list.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Offboard collects every step needed to close the account of a departing employee into a single screen.

sections.heading: Selecting the User
paragraphs: Enter the email address of the user to offboard in the search box and search. Once found, their profile and current status (active / suspended) are shown.

sections.heading: Offboard Steps
paragraphs: You can choose which steps to apply:

bullets.desc: Blocks the user from signing in.
Replaces the password with a random complex value.
Removes the user from every group they belong to.
Forwards incoming emails to an address you specify.

bullets.term: Change Org Unit / Remove from Directory:
bullets.desc: Moves the user to a target OU or hides them from the address list.

sections.heading: Execution
paragraphs: Apply the selected steps in sequence with "Start Offboard"; the result of each step is shown instantly. If a step fails, you can fix it and resume from where it stopped.

callout.text: These actions cannot be undone. Make sure you have selected the correct user before applying the remove from groups and suspend steps in particular.
